QuestInfo.name: The Culprit WILL Return
QuestInfo.0: Alpha and Beta heard from Lilishu that she saw Mu Tan enter the pharmacy on the eve of the crime. It'd only be fair to hear Mu Tan's side of the story.
QuestInfo.1: Mu Tan claims to have gone to bed early last night but you feel something is not right. You get the feeling Mu Tan might possibly be the culprit but you have no proof so you cannot single him out. They say criminals always return to the place of crime so go wait at location of the crime.
QuestInfo.2: Criminals always returned to the scene of the crime. Alpha and Beta decided to wait at the pharmacy for Mu Tan to return.

default.0: Go get whoever would dare to commit the atrocious act of eating meat in Mu Lung.

npc.0: I-I wasn't even near the Pharmacy!
